authorizationText: La idea es que configures tú lo más que puedas sin depender de mí. Evitar despliegues académicos redundantes al configurar Cloud Run para Classroom MCP.
reason: Cloud Run-only platform changes were triggering the Apps Script deployment because the Apps Script workflow listens to all .platform-changes authorization commits. Deterministically gate clasp credential restoration, Google API enablement, push, update deployment and postflight on actual source or canonical context diffs (src/ or config/academic-context.json) while still running authorization and regressions. Add a CI regression asserting gate coverage. Do not change Apps Script source, Site, or any Classroom resource.
